summary: A star rating input, with an optional shadow on each star.

props.name: count
props.description: How many stars to draw. Ignored when `icons` is set.

props.name: icons
props.description: A custom icon set, for a single-choice picker instead of N stars. When set, `value`/`defaultValue` index into it (0-based, `-1` for none) rather than counting filled stars, and `count`/`shadow` are ignored.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The rating on first render. Pair `value` with `onValueChange` instead if you are controlling it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new rating. Pressing the current rating again clears it to 0.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the stars.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: A rating that only reports one - an average, someone else's score. It draws at full strength and stays out of the tab order, announced once as a single value rather than as five controls. That is the difference from `disabled`, which dims, because it means "you could, but not now".

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on each star, which becomes a bordered chip. There is no surrounding card - this is what both shadow demos did.

props.name: animated
props.description: The press-scale on each star. Turn it off for static stars, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: emptyHint
props.description: Shown under the stars while nothing is selected. Once a rating is set it reads `3 / 5`.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content below the hint text, like a feedback field.
